translated_title: FGR: Ken Salazar Lied and the FBI Gave False Data; They Violated International Law in the Capture of El Mayo

meta_description: Prosecutor Ernestina Godoy says the FBI's role in seizing 'El Mayo' broke Mexican and international law, and Washington has repeatedly supplied false data.
